entry.name: mc.tanx~
entry.description: Use the tanx~ object to calculate and output a signal that is the tangent function of each sample of the input signal. The tanx~ object is a true π based function - it varies from the tanh~ object, whose output is based around 1 and is intended for use as a lookup table with the phasor~ object.
